Yeh (kafir) log kis cheez ke bare mein sawalaat kar rahe hain ?
Us zabardast waqiye ke bare mein
Jis mein khud un ki baatein mukhtalif hain.
Khabardar ! Unhein bohat jald pata lag jaye ga.
Dobara khabardar ! Unhein bohat jal pata lag jaye ga.
Kya hum ne zameen ko ek bichona nahin banaya ?
Aur paharon ko (zameen mein gri hui) mekhein ?
Aur tumhein (mard o aurat ke) joron ki shakal mein hum ne paida ae kiya.
Aur tumhari neend ko tahakan door karne ka zria hum ne banaya.
Aur raat ko parde ka sabab hum ne banaya.
Aur din ko rozi hasil karne ka waqt hum ne qarar diya.
Aur hum ne hi tumhare upar saat mazboot wajood (aasman) tameer kiye.
Aur hum ne hi ek dehakta hua chiraag (suraj) paida kiya.
Aur hum ne hi bhare hue baadalon se mosla dhar pani barsaya.
Taake us se ghla aur dusri sbzian bhi ugaein.
Aur ghne baghaat bhi.
Yaqeen jaano faisle ka din ek mutayin waqt hai.
Woh din jab soor phonka jaye ga to tum sab fauj dar fauj chale aao ge.
Aur aasman khol diya jaye ga to us ke darwaze hi darwaze bann jayen ge.
Aur paharon ko chalaya jaye ga to woh rait ke saraab ki shakal ikhtiyar karlen ge.
Yaqeen jaano jahannam ghat lagaye bithi hai.
Woh sarkashon ka thikana hai.
Jis mein woh muddaton us tarah rahen ge.
Ke us mein na woh kisi thandak ka mza chakkhein ge, aur na kisi peene ke qabil cheez ka hai.
Siwaye garum pani aur peep lahu ke.
Yeh un ka poora poora badla hoga.
Woh (apne aemaal ke) hisab ka qida nahin rakhte the.
Aur unhon ne hamari aayaton ko barh charh kar jhutlaya tha.
Aur hum ne har har cheez ko lakaha kar mehfooz kar rakhha hai.
Ab mza chkho ! Us liye ke hum tumhare liye saza ke siwa kisi cheez mein azafa nahin karen ge.
Jin logon ne taqwa ikhtiyar kiya tha, un ki be-shak bari jeet hai.
Baghaat aur angoor.
Aur no khiz hum umar larkiyan.
Aur chalkty hue paimane.
Wahan par woh na koi behoda baat sunen ge, aur na koi jhooti baat.
Yeh tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se sla hoga. (Allah ki) aisi deen hogi jo logon ke aemaal ke hisab se di jaye gi.
Usi Parwardigar ki taraf se jo sare aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan har cheez ka maalik, bohat meharban hai ! Kisi ki majal nahin hai ke us ke samne bol sake.
Jis din saari roohein aur farishte qatarein bana kar khre hon ge, us din siwaye us ke koi nahin bol sake ga. Jise khuda Rahman ne ijazat di ho, aur woh baat bhi theek kahe.
Woh din hai jo barhaqq hai. Ab jo chahaye woh apne Parwardigar ke paas thikana bana rkhe.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne tumhein ek aise azab se khabardar kardiya hai jo qareeb aane wala hai jis din har shaks woh aemaal aankhon se dekh le ga jo us ke haathon ne aage bhej rkhe hain, aur kafir yeh kahe ga ke kaash ! Mein mitti hojata.
